Aiden Oneill.note: O'Neill is a tempo player for Australia. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Aiden Oneill.noteZh: 他让Australia在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Ajdin Hrustic.note: Hrustić is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Australia, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Ajdin Hrustic.noteZh: 他给Australia提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Alessandro Circati.note: Circati has been part of Australia's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Alessandro Circati.noteZh: 他在Australia体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Awer Mabil.note: Mabil is an attacking change-up for Australia. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Awer Mabil.noteZh: 他是Australia的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Aziz Behich.note: Behich gives Australia another way to protect the edge of the box. His value shows up when the obvious pass disappears.
Aziz Behich.noteZh: 他给Australia那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Cameron Burgess.note: Burgess is defensive rotation for Australia. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Cameron Burgess.noteZh: 他是Australia后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Cameron Devlin.summary: Cammy Devlin is an Australia central midfielder from Heart of Midlothian who gives the national team ball-winning bite, pressing range, and combative energy.
Cameron Devlin.note: Devlin gives Australia a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Cameron Devlin.noteZh: 他是Australia的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Christian Volpato.note: Volpato is midfield insurance for Australia. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Christian Volpato.noteZh: 他给Australia一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Connor Metcalfe.note: Metcalfe is on the scoresheet for Australia, with his goal coming against Türkiye. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Connor Metcalfe.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Harry Souttar.note: Souttar has been part of Australia's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Harry Souttar.noteZh: 他给Australia后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Jackson Irvine.note: Irvine is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Australia, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Jackson Irvine.noteZh: 他给Australia提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Jacob Italiano.note: Italiano gives Australia another way to protect the edge of the box. His value shows up when the obvious pass disappears.
Jacob Italiano.noteZh: 他是Australia在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Jason Geria.note: Geria gives Australia a tournament role built on clean decisions. Watch whether his first touch settles the team or speeds the next attack.
Jason Geria.noteZh: 他在Australia的赛事角色建立在干净决策上。看他的第一脚触球，是让球队稳下来，还是让下一次进攻加速。

Jordan Bos.note: Bos is in the quiet-work part of Australia's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Jordan Bos.noteZh: 他是Australia主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Kai Trewin.note: Trewin gives Australia cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Kai Trewin.noteZh: 他是Australia后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Lucas Herrington.note: Herrington gives Australia defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Lucas Herrington.noteZh: 他是Australia后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Mathew Leckie.note: Leckie is the forward Australia can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Mathew Leckie.noteZh: 他给Australia替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Mathew Ryan.note: Ryan gives Australia a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Mathew Ryan.noteZh: 他在Australia首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Milos Degenek.note: Degenek is the kind of defender Australia can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Milos Degenek.noteZh: 他是Australia艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Mohamed Toure.summary: Mohamed Touré is an Australia centre-forward from Norwich City who gives the national team pace, penalty-box finishing, and direct channel runs.
Mohamed Toure.note: Touré is an attacking change-up for Australia. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Mohamed Toure.noteZh: 他是Australia的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Nestory Irankunda.note: Irankunda has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Türkiye. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Nestory Irankunda.noteZh: 他已经为Australia进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Nishan Velupillay.note: Velupillay gives Australia a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Nishan Velupillay.noteZh: 他是Australia在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Patrick Beach.note: Beach is the last voice in Australia's defensive shape. When pressure sticks, his job is to make the next action feel simple.
Patrick Beach.noteZh: 他承担了Australia的门将时间。重点是稳手、清楚开球，以及让身前后卫不用慌。

Paul Izzo.note: Izzo gives Australia a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Paul Izzo.noteZh: 他在Australia首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Paul Okon-Engstler.note: Okon-Engstler has supplied one of Australia's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Paul Okon-Engstler.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Australia创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Tete Yengi.note: Yengi gives Australia a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Tete Yengi.noteZh: 他是Australia在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。
